name: manymotions-fitness-video
description: Turn an exercise or routine into a workout short with an AI athlete in a gym, outdoors or at home and a short narration, produced in your ManyMotions account.

interface.longDescription:
Turn an exercise or a routine into a short workout video with an AI athlete.

Describe the workout, where it happens (gym, outdoors or at home), how the athlete looks and what the narration should say, plus the spoken language, format and length. The plugin prepares a brief and shows the number of scenes and the credits it will use. When you confirm, ManyMotions writes the script scene by scene, generates the keyframes and the scene videos with the effort and form shown clearly and an AI narration, and edits the final cut. A video takes several minutes; ChatGPT reports the progress and returns the link to the MP4.

For trainers, gyms and fitness creators who need workout content without filming.

Limitations: the videos illustrate exercises and are not medical or professional training advice. It does not edit uploaded footage, analyze your form from a video or use photos of real people. Producing a video uses your signed-in ManyMotions account; preparing a brief does not need an account. If you are not signed in, the plugin gives a link where the same brief opens on ManyMotions.

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
capabilities: Track progress and return the MP4
defaultPrompt: A 15-second kettlebell finisher in the gym with three moves and form cues
Hill sprints at sunrise, motivational narration, 30 seconds, vertical
A 10-minute home mobility routine shown in 45 seconds, narrated in Spanish

positive.prompt: Make a 15-second gym video of a three-move kettlebell finisher with form cues, athlete a woman in her 30s in black training gear.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with setting gym, 15 seconds, 3 scenes and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.prompt: Hill sprints at sunrise with motivational narration, outdoors, square 1:1, 30 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with setting outdoor, format 1:1 and length 30 seconds (5 scenes), and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.description: Produce a video and return it
positive.prompt: An 8-second video of push-ups at home with one key form cue. Yes, generate it now and send me the video link when it is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The brief is prepared (2 scenes, 500 credits). After the go-ahead (if ChatGPT asks to confirm first, reply "Generate it"), generate_video starts the production in the signed-in account (state processing, credits used shown). get_video reports the current step; asked again once the production has completed (usually 5 to 10 minutes), it returns the absolute MP4 link and the ManyMotions link to open it.

positive.description: Outdoor workout in a wide format
positive.prompt: A 60-second outdoor stair-running workout for intermediate runners, 16:9, with cues on posture.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with setting outdoor, format 16:9, length 60 seconds (8 scenes) and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

positive.prompt: A home mobility routine for desk workers with hips and shoulders, narrated in Spanish, 45 seconds.
positive.expected_behavior: A brief with setting home, language Spanish, 45 seconds and the credits required. Nothing is generated.

negative.prompt: Watch the video of my squat I uploaded and tell me what I am doing wrong.
I have a herniated disc, design a rehab program for me.
Write me a 12-week marathon training plan.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing a video uses credits of the user's existing ManyMotions account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission with no functional changes: prepare a brief, produce the video in the linked ManyMotions account and follow it to the MP4.
